claims.statement: UC-05 is a multi-step hierarchical diagnostic agent covering K4/K5 while UC-10 is a scheduled anomaly detection and alerting workflow covering K2/K5.
UC-05 persists an analysis plan where each step is todo/doing/done/skipped/failed and enforces branching plus depth cap around 4 levels and query cap around 20.
UC-05 attribution requires summed cause contributions to reconcile with the total delta within 5%, verified automatically.
UC-05 validates the baseline phenomenon first and pauses at plan creation with a LangGraph interrupt so users can view and edit dimensions before heavy queries run.
UC-05 checkpoints after each step so a restart after step 2 resumes from the last checkpoint without rerunning completed queries.
A failed UC-05 query step retries with a bound and is then marked failed while analysis continues on other branches.

UC-10 scans subscribed metric-by-slice series on a 07:00 schedule plus manual trigger, fetching via shared db-tools MCP without a separate pool and checkpointing per metric/slice so one slice failure does not stop the run.

UC-10 detection is code-based robust z-score over a trimmed 28-day window with sigma floor and EPS plus week-over-week comparison, gated by min_support so under-supported slices are skipped rather than alerted.
UC-10 severity routes critical alerts immediately while warning and info are grouped into a digest.

Anomalous UC-10 slices trigger 1-2 dimension LLM drill-down through sqlGuard and policy checks, and every alert must contain metric, current value, expected value, deviation, localized segment, and evidence SQL.

Alert deduplication uses SHA-256 over recipientId|metric|dimensionKey|date|direction, checks the fingerprint before send, and inserts into PostgreSQL app_state.alert_history only after successful delivery, with a 24-hour dedup window.

Alert channel sends use a 10-second timeout with at most 3 attempts and exponential backoff, retry only retryable 5xx/429/408/timeout/network failures, and append exhausted retries to failed_alerts_queue.jsonl without writing dedup history.
UC-10 applies recipient RBAC and masking at SQL build time with MCP scopes plus a second PII scan before send, never as post-hoc text filtering.
Seeded fluctuation scenarios, anomaly points, and injection rows in data/seeded_scenarios.md are hidden from the agent and its retrieval context.
The pair exposes root-cause-analysis and mandatory anomaly-alert skills with when-to-use, inputs/outputs, steps, constraints, examples, and final checks, without arbitrary-execution scripts.

UC-10 is a scheduled code-first scan (pure-code detection over daily series, model-assisted drill-down only on anomalies, severity routing, deduped delivery), distinct from interactive multi-step root-cause diagnosis.

UC-05 enforces branching on dominant contribution share, depth cap 4, query cap 20, per-query bounded retries marking steps failed without failing the run, and waterfall attribution reconciliation within 5% with no fabricated causes.

Detection uses a trimmed 28-day mean and standard deviation with an effective-sigma floor, week-over-week change with an EPS guard, minimum-support gating with skipped_insufficient_support, and critical/warning severity routing where normal days emit no alert.

Generic HITL pause/resume has landed: pauseForApproval wraps LangGraph interrupt, resumeDecision builds Command resume on the same stable chat thread id, proven DB-free on MemorySaver without re-running completed nodes.

Durable checkpoint and host resume path has landed: createCheckpointer builds PostgresSaver on langgraph schema from HARNESS_STATE_DATABASE_URL with fail-fast setup and agent_ro rejection, createHostPorts injects it with AppStateStore, and POST /api/runs/:runId/resume resumes via Command on the same thread.

Dedup persistence uses canonical SHA-256 fingerprints, a pre-send hasFingerprint SELECT with a 24-hour window, and a single write-after-send INSERT into app_state.alert_history with conflict refresh only for expired fingerprints.

UC-05 orchestrator has landed as packages/agent/src/subgraphs/rootCauseAnalysis.ts with createRcaRuntime entry registered under RCA_UC_ID and routed by routeQuestionToUc; only the UC-10 runner/sender (alerts/*, subscriptions.yaml, node-cron/manual CLI) and both domain skill directories remain planned with no implementation files.
Recipient policy is applied at SQL build time through role-derived row predicates and catalog-gated columns, and a second PII regex scan before send blocks delivery with PII_BLOCKED.

UC-10 acceptance covers spike-up, drop-down, normal-day no-alert with false-positive measurement, same-day rerun deduplication across recipients, channel-failure retry into a failed queue with later resend, and zero PII leakage with token/cost/latency reporting.

The frozen root builder compiles a fixed START to END chain with budgetGuard, understand, retrieve, router, ucEntry/defaultEntry, statusCheck, vizSeam, and answer nodes; the router dispatches only by overlay allowlist and a tripped budgetGuard short-circuits directly to answer without model or MCP I/O.

UC-05 and UC-10 extend the agent without editing graph.ts by registering UcEntryHandler implementations through registerUC or RootGraphDeps.ucHandlers overlay merge, sharing the single (state, runtime) handler signature.

Registry transport identity comes from RunnableConfig.configurable populated by the host and readTracerContext fails closed when any of mcpUrl, token, runId, userId, roleScope, threadId, or tracesDir is missing.

The trace writer mints spanId via randomUUID, runs row-level redactRow plus a redactPII stringify backstop before serialization, validates against the shared trace contract, and appends one redacted JSON line per event to traces/<runId>.jsonl.

The hierarchical span emitter wraps work between start and end events with parentSpanId linkage and ok flag on both success and failure, and standardizes skill_call, llm_call, and tool_call helpers whose tool payloads carry counts, column names, masking and row-scope metadata, and outcome codes, never cell values.

UC-05 drill-down and UC-10 series queries share the ValidatedQueryExecutor path of selective describe, sqlGuard plus LocalQuerySafetyGate pre-check, explain plus run_query, and bounded repair, with hard caps on attempts, detail limits, preview rows, and run budgets.
Why/variance diagnostic questions with directional change or comparison route deterministically to RCA_UC_ID (root-cause-analysis) while definitional/formula lookups bypass to the default route.

parseRcaIntent deterministically extracts metric (net_revenue/aov/return_rate with formula components), explicit direction, and current/baseline periods including Vietnamese month, quarter, week, and YoY forms with a September-vs-August 2026 fallback.

validateBaseline runs two baseline/current fetches via fetchBaseline or ValidatedQueryExecutor with reference SQL, rejects generated SQL missing period date bounds, treats <1% moves as insignificant no-data, and rejects explicit-direction mismatches as false premises with true direction and values.

createPlan returns null on invalid baseline, builds 3 region steps for additive metrics and a 2-formula-plus-regions tree for ratio metrics, and pins maxQueriesLimit 20, maxDepthLimit 4, and drilldownThreshold 30.0.

executeAnalysis scans todo steps, enforces query/depth budgets with MAX_QUERIES_REACHED/MAX_DEPTH_REACHED skips, retries each step at most twice before marking failed and continuing, expands significant branches along region-channel-category-product, and prunes weak branches to skipped plus residual.

Waterfall verification sums disjoint leaf deltas plus signed residual and passes when signed mathDiffRatio <=0.05; primary causes select >=50% contributors or top 3, synthesized into a schema-validated RootCauseAnswer markdown report.

UC-05 human review pauses with action review_analysis_plan carrying plan/currentPlan, accepts APPROVE to execute, schema-parsed MODIFY to replace steps/plan, REJECT/CANCEL/DENY to stop, and rejects anything else; the gate is skipped when no execution backend exists or skipHitlReview is set.

Each executed RCA step appends an __interrupt__ putWrites checkpoint with currentPlan/plan, and resume rehydrates from state.analysisPlan or the richest thread interrupt write, failing closed when a resume has no recoverable plan.

Date-guarded MCP wrapper blocks explain_query/run_query whose SQL fails verifySqlDateFilter before MCP/DB I/O; the verifier requires every UNION and top-level OR branch to bind the same target-table date column to both period endpoints.

Step SQL inherits parent dimension filters via collectInheritedFilters and buildStepQuery joins only required dimension tables with mandatory purchase_date bounds, with metric-specific SELECT shapes for net revenue, AOV, denominators, and return rate.

scripts/test-uc05-live.ts proves the live UC-05 baseline/planner path by booting a real MCP gateway, injecting a fake SQL model, invoking createRcaRuntime entry, and asserting ok status with run_query usage and all-todo initial steps.

UC-10 subscription configuration is config/subscriptions.yaml version 1 with five daily subscriptions (return-rate, net-revenue, cancellation-rate, order-count, review-score), each carrying primary/suggested dimensions, recipient and role, channel, digest preference, absoluteThreshold and minSupport, validated by SubscriptionsConfigSchema with snake_case preprocessing, MinSupport floor of 15, and a four-member AlertChannel allowlist.

The subscription loader resolves configuration from an explicit file path or the repo-root-relative DEFAULT_SUBSCRIPTIONS_PATH, parses YAML through SubscriptionsConfigSchema, and throws an explicit syntax error on malformed YAML.

Anomaly detection is pure-code detectAnomaly with trimmed mean/standard-deviation helpers, effective-sigma floor, week-over-week guard, absolute-threshold check, support-count gating, insufficient-history handling, and direction classification over numeric aggregates only.

Severity is critical on absolute-threshold breach or absZ>=3.0 or absWoW>=50, warning for 2.0<=absZ<3.0, with support-count suppression first and insufficient-history suppression that still allows absolute-threshold critical alerts.

The offline detector suite pins spike/drop scenarios with severity and direction bounds, trimmed-baseline contamination resistance, sigma-floor behavior on flat series, injection-laden metadata producing pure-math results, low-support suppression, and zero-division plus from-series edge cases.

Both domain skill contracts have landed: skills/root-cause-analysis/SKILL.md for the UC-05 diagnostic workflow and skills/anomaly-alert/SKILL.md pinning subscription loading via SubscriptionsConfigSchema, trimmed z-score plus WoW plus min_support detection, 1-2-dimension read-only drill-down with RBAC, and six-field alert composition.
